sections.heading: Overview
bullets: An earth-themed fight built around baiting and breaking pillars before they empower Adina. 8-minute enrage.

sections.heading: Pillar empowerment
bullets: Every damaged pillar still standing gives Adina a stack: +20% outgoing damage, -20% incoming damage per stack. Getting all 5 pillars to break during Boulder Barrage keeps this from stacking — position two players behind each pillar.

<mark>Tectonic Upheaval</mark> marks the 5 furthest players with an expanding circle that locks onto a tile and raises a pillar — the pillar itself kills anyone nearby when it rises, and sends out a shockwave that cripples/immobilizes anyone who doesn't jump over it. Baiters hold at max melee range, let it lock, then return to the boss and jump the shockwave.

sections.heading: Radiant Blindness & Diamond Palisade
bullets: <mark>Diamond Palisade</mark> turns her skin to diamond (reflects projectiles, buffs herself) and ripples damage to players and pillars alike.
Two seconds into Diamond Palisade, she casts <mark>Radiant Blindness</mark> — anyone not facing away from her gets a 20-second uncleansable blind. Get to your pillar and turn around during this.
<mark>Sand Geyser</mark> launches nearby players into the air and blinds them — don't stand close to her without a reason.

sections.heading: Sand Wall (every 25%)
bullets: Adina goes invulnerable and a Sand Wall sweeps south to north — run counterclockwise around the arena to stay ahead of it; getting caught is an instant kill.

After the wall finishes, hands spawn (2 normally, 4 during the 50%/25% phases): Hand of Erosion stacks vulnerability, Hand of Eruption launches a knockback projectile. Kill Erosion hands first, and block or dodge Eruption's shot so you don't get knocked into quicksand.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 8:00 — Adina deals +200% damage past this point.
